sentences.text: Berlin -LRB- -LSB- bəɹˈlɪn -RSB- , -LSB- bɛɐ̯ˈliːn -RSB- -RRB- is the capital and the largest city of Germany as well as one of its 16 constituent states .	capital	Capital city	Germany	Germany	states	states of Germany

With a population of approximately 3.7 million , Berlin is the second most populous city proper and the seventh most populous urban area in the European Union .	European Union	European Union	most populous city proper	List of largest cities in the European Union by population within city limits	most populous urban area	List of urban areas in the European Union

Located in northeastern Germany on the banks of the rivers Spree and Havel , it is the centre of the Berlin-Brandenburg Metropolitan Region , which has roughly 6 million residents from more than 180 nations .	Spree	Spree	Germany	Germany	Havel	Havel	Berlin-Brandenburg Metropolitan Region	Berlin/Brandenburg Metropolitan Region
Due to its location in the European Plain , Berlin is influenced by a temperate seasonal climate .	European Plain	European Plain	temperate	Temperate climate
Around one-third of the city 's area is composed of forests , parks , gardens , rivers , canals and lakes .

First documented in the 13th century and situated at the crossing of two important historic trade routes , Berlin became the capital of the Margraviate of Brandenburg -LRB- 14171701 -RRB- , the Kingdom of Prussia -LRB- 1701 -- 1918 -RRB- , the German Empire -LRB- 1871 -- 1918 -RRB- , the Weimar Republic -LRB- 1919 -- 1933 -RRB- and the Third Reich -LRB- 1933 -- 1945 -RRB- .	capital	Capital city	Margraviate of Brandenburg	Margraviate of Brandenburg	Kingdom of Prussia	Kingdom of Prussia	German Empire	German Empire	Weimar Republic	Weimar Republic	Third Reich	Third Reich
Berlin in the 1920s was the third largest municipality in the world .	Berlin in the 1920s	1920s Berlin

After World War II and its subsequent occupation by the victorious countries , the city was divided ; East Berlin was declared capital of East Germany , while West Berlin became a de facto West German exclave , surrounded by the Berlin Wall -LRB- 1961 -- 1989 -RRB- and East German territory . Following German reunification in 1990 , Berlin once again became the capital of all-Germany .	capital	Capital city	Germany	Germany	German reunification	German reunification
Berlin is a world city of culture , politics , media and science .	world city	Global city

Its economy is based on high-tech firms and the service sector , encompassing a diverse range of creative industries , research facilities , media corporations and convention venues .	high-tech	High tech	creative industries	creative industries
Berlin serves as a continental hub for air and rail traffic and has a highly complex public transportation network .
The metropolis is a popular tourist destination .	tourist destination	Tourism in Germany
Significant industries also include IT , pharmaceuticals , biomedical engineering , clean tech , biotechnology , construction and electronics .	IT	information technology	biotechnology	biotechnology
Modern Berlin is home to world renowned universities , orchestras , museums , entertainment venues and is host to many sporting events .
Its urban setting has made it a sought-after location for international film productions .	film productions	List of films set in Berlin
The city is well known for its festivals , diverse architecture , nightlife , contemporary arts and a high quality of living .	high quality of living	World's most liveable cities
